facts.text: Why does Warwick the smith refuse to sell the mithril chain shirt he displays?

classification.grounding_justification: Farmer Gill reports that Warwick always refuses to sell the shirt, but offers no reason; it is an unexplained refusal, mildly notable because the shop otherwise has little to sell.
classification.investigative_depth_justification: Asking Warwick or learning his reasons would likely settle it in one step.
classification.narrative_payoff_justification: The reason might be mildly interesting but mainly matters if the party wants the shirt.
classification.investigative_potential_justification: Warwick is in town and could simply be asked; little beyond that.
